svg.title: HRMS Overtime Logging — System Architecture & Validation Flow
svg.desc: Two-panel technical diagram: top panel shows the MERN/MySQL system architecture with client, React frontend, Node/Express API, Sequelize ORM, and Dockerized MySQL layers; bottom panel shows the 60-hour monthly limit validation subprocess as a flowchart with decision diamond.
